implementation_role: nonmigratory claim-level survival classification only; no theorem is rederived and no manuscript is edited

solution_and_scope.current_object: perfect Bayesian equilibrium under local outcome-signature relevance, yes at payoff-relevant equality, and explicit full-profile completion at zero relevance
solution_and_scope.comparison_object: the exact Cartesian product of whole entry-augmented assessments under two fixed counterfactual rules
solution_and_scope.validated_common_domain: every primitive-admissible N>=3 case exported by the frozen entry interfaces
solution_and_scope.selection_boundary: no cross-rule selection, common randomization, rank matching, scalar splice, endogenous rule choice, or universal ranking is supplied
solution_and_scope.historical_use: allowed sources identify candidate claims and locators only; no historical proof, equation, label, or number is evidence for current validity
solution_and_scope.migration_status: blocked; this candidate classifies claims but authorizes no edit or compilation of formal_model_v5.Rmd, formal_model_v6.Rmd, or their outputs

matrix_semantics.survives: the exact historical claim survives within the current evidence and stated scope; wording is still rewritten to attach the complete current object
matrix_semantics.conditional: only the expressly stated subclass, domain, projection, or conditional identity survives
matrix_semantics.changes: a nearby object survives but the historical statement must be replaced by the precise current object
matrix_semantics.rejected: the historical statement is false as a characterization or generalization of the current game
matrix_semantics.pending: the current approved interfaces do not identify the claim and no conclusion is made
matrix_semantics.outside_scope: the claim concerns a different game or quarantined historical protocol; it is neither current evidence nor a current theorem
matrix_semantics.evidence_rule: every row contains one or more repo-relative path@sha256#locator references to exact approved current artifacts
matrix_semantics.historical_locator_rule: every source locator is a checked inclusive line range in an allowed read-only inventory source

historical_inventory.role: protected historical manuscript; claim inventory only
protected target manuscript; claim inventory only and no migration
protected prior derivation; inventory of one candidate claim only, never proof evidence

prohibited_promotions: treating a historical proof or formula as current evidence
assigning a historical scalar label to a current equilibrium assessment
describing the current object with a quarantined solution-concept acronym or an invented equality-convention label
describing the simultaneous ballot as sequential within the ballot
collapsing a full assessment correspondence to proposer payoff, collective gross value, or a selected endpoint
claiming universal formation nesting, strict H rent, majority no-screening, or institutional dominance from an existence construction or payoff floor
editing or compiling a protected manuscript on the authority of this candidate

required_negative_tests: missing current evidence rejects the row
changing a locked status to a stronger status rejects the matrix
changing a protected hash rejects the matrix
copying an archived formula or branch label into a current replacement rejects the matrix
assigning a historical label to a current PBE rejects the matrix
marking an archived formula or rejected scalar theorem as survives rejects the matrix
changing either approved comparison dependency invalidates the candidate

review.consumer_rule: no manuscript or integrated derivation may consume this candidate before both reviewers accept its exact hash

invalidation: any byte change to the approved comparison, comparison review bundle, authoritative CSV, protected inventory sources, or any cited current evidence artifact invalidates this candidate and every later migration consumer
artifact_hash_policy: SHA-256 is computed externally over exact UTF-8 bytes; no self-referential digest is embedded
